ios.desc:
Budget app for income, expenses, household budget and finances – MoneyControl.
Keep track of your finances, manage income and expenses, and plan your budget easily and clearly.

MoneyControl is a powerful budget app that has been continuously developed for over 15 years. It focuses on simplicity, clarity and full control over your finances – not more, but also not less.


EASY INCOME & EXPENSE TRACKING

A good budget app must be fast and easy to use. With MoneyControl, you can record income and expenses in just a few seconds – even while on the go:
    •    Add a new income or expense
    •    Enter the amount
    •    Optionally select category, account, person or note
    •    Done

With shortcuts, recurring or frequent expenses can be added even faster with a single tap.


HOUSEHOLD BUDGET & FINANCES AT A GLANCE

MoneyControl helps you plan your household budget and keep your finances under control:
    •    Set personal budgets
    •    Manage recurring income and expenses automatically
    •    Preview upcoming months
    •    Visual charts for income and expenses
    •    Powerful search
    •    Account management and transfers
    •    Flexible financial month settings
    •    CSV export for Excel
    •    Internal backups

Optional extensions allow you to:
    •    Attach receipt photos to expenses
    •    Create, print and share PDF reports


PRIVACY & CONTROL

Your financial data stays under your control. Synchronization is only used if you explicitly activate it.


FREE TO TRY

MoneyControl can be downloaded and tested for free. The free version allows up to 20 entries per month.
A one-time in-app purchase removes this limitation permanently. Extensions are also unlocked with one-time purchases and can be used on all your iOS devices.
